name: otis
description: Curated SpiderByte workflows for governed datasets, Runs, artifacts, local ML, and approvals in Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Curated SpiderByte Runs, datasets, artifacts, ML, and approvals.
interface.longDescription: Otis provides a narrow semantic MCP surface for customer-controlled SpiderByte daemons: workspace and project discovery, governed Runs, bounded dataset profiling and SQL analysis, baseline ML workflows, artifact inspection, capability discovery, and approval requests. It does not provide SpiderByte-hosted compute or identity.
defaultPrompt: Analyze a dataset through SpiderByte's governed local workflow.
Inspect a completed Run and its bounded artifacts.
Request approval before a restricted or compute-consuming action.
